sources.authors: Silje Nornes Bryntesen; Armin Kahrom; Jacob Joseph Lamb; Ignat Tolstorebrov; Odne Stokke Burheim
sources.title: Experimental Analysis of Drying Kinetics and Quality Aspects of Convection-Dried Cathodes at Laboratory Scale
sources.locator: PDF p.9 Figure 4 and Table 5; conditions pp.4-5; data availability p.17
sources.data_kind: Figure 4 digitized approximate experimental points; Table 5 transcribed values
sources.conditions: NMC111/CB/PVDF 85:10:5 solid ratio; NMP solvent; laboratory coating; Figure 4: 100 C, 1 m/s convection
sources.processing: 18 grey marker centres; x=(px-269)/1662*1000 s; y=(1269-py)/1107*2.5 kg/kg. No curve fitting or extrapolation.
sources.limits: Not a 60 vs 65 wt% comparison, not NIR data, not an industrial exit-NMP specification. Figure 4 representative critical point differs from Table 5 group-average value; not merged.

sources.authors: Andrew Weng; Peyman Mohtat; Peter M. Attia; Valentin Sulzer; Suhak Lee; Greg Less; Anna G. Stefanopoulou
sources.title: Predicting the impact of formation protocols on battery lifetime immediately after manufacturing
sources.locator: Author CSV: form_6hr_rest_delta_voltage_v_0_to_{1..6}_hr; c3_dch_cap_at_c{2,55,158,261,364}_ah. Preprint Fig.S1 p.22 and formation protocol section.
sources.license: Underlying dataset: CC BY-NC 4.0 (DataCite record); author CSV is a 2022 processed release of the study data.
sources.data_kind: Author-processed experimental values, not raw high-frequency cycler logs
sources.conditions: NMC111/graphite 2.36 Ah pouch; 40 built; cell 9 excluded due to tab-weld issue, 39 in CSV. Formation and 6 h rest at room temperature. Later cycling groups RT and 45 C.
sources.processing: Keep all 39 cells. Voltage drop uses author-smoothed features; 0 h is defined reference. V to mV x1000. C/3 RPT capacity divided by each cell own cycle-2 capacity. Use 5 shared measurement cycles to avoid changing cohort. Median and IQR are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
sources.limits: No internal-short positive labels; cannot validate screening sensitivity or shorten 14 d aging. 14 h and 56 h exclude diagnostics; C company 20 to 16 h is a separate target. Cycles are not calendar time.

drying_pixel_calibration.note: Pixel-picking tolerance only; excludes experimental and original figure error.
